note: When the toy reels go live on Instagram and YouTube together (IST), 30 minutes before each audience peak: 06:00 = 7:30 PM New York (US prime time peaks 8-9 PM ET), 12:30 = India lunch peak (1 PM IST), 20:30 = India prime time (peaks 9 PM IST; also 3 PM UK). GitHub starts scheduled runs up to ~2 hours late, so each slot has runs 4, 3 and 2 hours before it; the first one to start uploads and then waits for the exact minute. If you change these times, change the cron lines in .github/workflows/post-toyreels.yml too.
